name: F1 1990
author: Swofty
description: Turns the F1 2026 season into the 1990 season: 1990 teams, drivers, calendar, rules and cars, in Driver Career and Grand Prix.

options.label: Silent agent in 1990 careers
options.description: Mutes the agent's voice lines (subtitles stay) in 1990 careers only; 2025 and 2026 careers keep her voice.

options.label: 1990 power-unit rules
options.description: No power-unit wear and no power-unit grid penalties for the 1990 cars (f1_1990 and f1_1990b packages); every other car keeps the stock rules.

options.label: 1990 qualifying engines
options.description: The qualifying engine R&D lines add their Engine Power only in Friday and Saturday qualifying of a 1990 career.

options.label: 1990 R&D colours and icons
options.description: Gives each R&D department a 1990 colour and a period icon in 1990 careers only; 2025 and 2026 careers keep the stock look.

options.label: 1990 Career tile
options.description: Adds a 1990 Career tile next to the 2025 and 2026 Career tiles.

options.label: 1990 career setup
options.description: A new 1990 Driver Career goes from the settings straight to Choose Driver with the 1990 drivers: no F2 start, season length, team, driver icons or driver type step. 2025 and 2026 careers keep every step.

options.label: Dry tyres in Friday qualifying
options.description: At the start of Friday qualifying, makes every unused dry set usable (the game hands them back and only allows inters and wets there). Not needed when no_tyre_allocation turns the allocation off.

options.label: Replay room for 26 cars
options.description: Moves a replay recorder state that outgrows its buffer (per-car systems at the 26-car race start) to a larger buffer. Does nothing while every state fits, as on a 22-car grid.

options.label: Cars
options.description: Cars on the 1990 grid. 22 runs the 11 strongest teams; 26 adds Larrousse and Dallara and needs 26-car track layers.

options.label: Career year
options.description: The year the Driver Career starts in.

options.label: Soft sets per session
options.description: New supersoft tyre sets handed out in each 1990 session: practice 1, practice 2, Friday qualifying, Saturday qualifying and the race. No medium or hard sets are given.

options.label: No weekend tyre allocation
options.description: Turns off the weekend tyre allocation screen for the 1990 compound class, as the classic class does. Test switch for the Friday qualifying tyre problem.

options.label: Pre-race grid cutscene
options.description: Plays the grid cutscene before a 1990 race start, which brings the safety car onto the grid.

options.label: Pre-race grid rundown
options.description: Plays the camera run down the grid before a 1990 race start, which ends on the safety car.

options.label: Steering wheel display
options.description: The dial the 1990 cars show: the F2 dial, with no ERS or override readouts, or the modern F1 dial.

options.label: No active aero
options.description: Turns off the 2026 active aero rules on the 1990 cars (the f1_1990 vehicle package).

options.label: ERS
options.description: Removed takes the hybrid system out of the cars. Zeroed keeps it with no harvest, deploy or override, for when removal misbehaves.

options.label: Tyre size
options.description: The tyre radius the 1990 handling files use, matching the 13-inch tyre set of the 1990 car pack. Raised also lifts the ride height by the smaller radius.

options.label: B-spec cars
options.description: In 1990 careers, a team whose B-spec R&D milestone is complete races its B-spec car from the next session on (AI teams too).
